# What does a nanny really cost once the payroll taxes are in?

> Free nanny tax calculator: the real yearly and hourly cost of a household employee with Social Security, Medicare, FUTA and state unemployment, plus a take-home-to-gross converter. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it answers

In 2026 a household employer owes Social Security and Medicare tax once one employee's cash wages reach $3,000 for the year: 7.65% withheld from the employee and 7.65% from you, with Social Security stopping at $184,500. Federal unemployment (FUTA) tax applies once you pay $1,000 in cash wages in any calendar quarter: 6% of the first $7,000 per employee, usually 0.6% after the credit for state unemployment tax. Source: IRS Publication 926 (2026). As of 2026-11-14.
